products.text:
Type: southwestern runner rug
Use: covering a floor, softening a walkway; hallway, kitchen, living room, bedroom
Style: bohemian, traditional, rustic
Materials: low-pile woven synthetic fibers
Colors: dark teal blue, rust orange, cream, navy, terracotta
Shape: long narrow rectangle, repeating diamond medallions in an all-over tribal pattern, patterned border, low flat pile, medium visual weight
Feel: warm, rich, cozy, worldly
Goes with: warm wood floors, navy or dark cabinets, brass accents; bohemian, rustic or traditional rooms

Type: red mosaic area rug
Use: anchoring a seating area, covering a floor; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: bohemian, traditional
Materials: wool, low flat pile
Colors: deep warm red, pink, orange, cream, teal accents
Shape: rectangle, large central diamond medallion with smaller diamonds, all-over geometric mosaic of small motifs, slim border, medium size, bold visual weight
Feel: warm, vibrant, cozy, lively
Goes with: dark wood floors, grey upholstery, woven baskets; bohemian or eclectic rooms

Type: striped flatweave wool rug
Use: covering a floor, defining an entry; entryway, living room, bedroom, home office
Style: modern, bohemian, rustic
Materials: wool flatweave, small corner tassels
Colors: warm sand beige, cream, brown, red, yellow, blue accents
Shape: small rectangle, gabbeh-inspired irregular horizontal stripes with color-block bands, flat thin weave, light visual weight
Feel: earthy, relaxed, casual, warm
Goes with: natural wood, brick or terracotta floors, green plants; rustic, bohemian or modern rooms

Type: distressed Persian area rug
Use: anchoring a seating area, covering a floor; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: traditional, bohemian, contemporary
Materials: low-pile woven fibers with a faded distressed finish
Colors: cool sky blue, cream, navy, sage accents
Shape: rectangle, repeating lattice of medallion motifs, faded worn-look edges, slim border, low pile, medium visual weight
Feel: calm, fresh, vintage, relaxed
Goes with: dark wood floors, cognac leather, white walls; coastal, bohemian or transitional rooms

Type: chevron runner rug
Use: covering a walkway; hallway, entryway, bedroom, kitchen
Style: contemporary, minimalist, modern
Materials: plush pile with carved high-low texture
Colors: medium cool grey, charcoal grey
Shape: long narrow rectangle, tone-on-tone carved zigzag chevron pattern, plain edges, soft dense pile, light visual weight
Feel: calm, soft, understated
Goes with: mid or dark wood floors, white walls, wicker baskets; minimalist, modern or Scandinavian rooms

Type: geometric runner rug
Use: covering a walkway; hallway, kitchen, entryway, bedroom
Style: contemporary, minimalist, modern
Materials: low-pile woven fibers with a textured line pattern
Colors: light grey, taupe, off-white
Shape: long narrow rectangle, repeating triangles of nested lines forming a geometric grid, tone-on-tone texture, flat low pile, light visual weight
Feel: clean, airy, calm
Goes with: dark wood floors, white or grey cabinets, silver hardware; modern or minimalist rooms

Type: vintage-look fringed area rug
Use: anchoring a seating or dining area; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: bohemian, rustic, contemporary
Materials: woven fibers with a worn vintage finish, white knotted fringe
Colors: warm grey, charcoal, ivory
Shape: large rectangle, small all-over geometric pattern framed by banded tribal borders, fringed short ends, low pile, medium visual weight
Feel: muted, earthy, relaxed, timeless
Goes with: dark wood floors, woven baskets, neutral upholstery; rustic, farmhouse or bohemian rooms

Type: striped fringed area rug
Use: anchoring a seating or dining area; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, modern, bohemian
Materials: woven pile with textured stripes, white tasseled fringe
Colors: charcoal grey, navy black, light grey, white
Shape: large rectangle, dense narrow horizontal stripes of nubby texture, small tassels on short ends, medium pile, solid visual weight
Feel: moody, cozy, grounded
Goes with: dark wood floors, beige upholstery, natural baskets; modern or industrial rooms

Type: patterned wool runner rug
Use: covering a walkway; hallway, kitchen, entryway, bedroom
Style: contemporary, modern, bohemian
Materials: wool with a heathered textured pile
Colors: denim blue, light grey, white flecks
Shape: long narrow rectangle, tone-on-tone abstract diamond and leaf-like pattern, heathered surface, plain edges, soft pile, light visual weight
Feel: relaxed, cool, casual, soft
Goes with: light wood or parquet floors, teal or white cabinets, stainless steel; modern or coastal rooms

Type: distressed medallion area rug
Use: anchoring a seating area, covering a floor; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: bohemian, traditional, glam
Materials: low-pile woven fibers with a faded vintage finish
Colors: hot pink, coral orange, navy, cream
Shape: rectangle, central floral medallion with all-over ornate motifs, distressed faded areas, border band, low pile, bold visual weight
Feel: vibrant, playful, warm, eclectic
Goes with: dark wood floors, grey upholstery, woven baskets; bohemian or eclectic rooms
